elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3 applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Order Form for any reason and requires Vendor, at Customer's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) expressly provides for transition assistance for up to six (6) months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) expressly states that transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor returns all Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) requires Vendor to return all Customer Data following expiry or termination.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) expressly sets a thirty-day deadline running from expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) expressly requires a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor deletes Customer Data from its systems.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(c) requires Vendor thereafter to delete Customer Data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(c) expressly requires Vendor to certify the deletion in writing.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) requires transition assistance upon expiry or termination when requested by Customer.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: The stated period of up to six months encompasses and exceeds the fallback ninety-day assistance period.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor exports Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The obligation to return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format constitutes a data export.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) expressly requires return of the data within thirty days of expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative redline satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It adds only the required exit-assistance, data-return, deletion, and certification obligations while leaving the existing payment, delivery, and refund terms unchanged. The drafting is clear, though deletion is sequenced only by “thereafter” rather than by a fixed deadline.
